title: Design: Long contact and payer names stay in their Authorizer list rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West), with one contact, contact A1, whose first name is long with no spaces, at least 30 characters (for example Maximilianbartholomewjohnsonwilliams), who can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest), with one contact, contact B1, whose last name includes the characters & " ' < > (for example O'Neil "Jr" <Parts> & Co), who can be picked as Authorizer.
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-10-after-authorizer-list-top.png, bt-p2-11-after-authorizer-list-bottom.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Authorizer field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The list starts with "No authorizer", then contact A1, then contact B1.
  • Contact A1's name and customer A's name on the second line stay inside contact A1's row: no part of them covers contact B1's row.
  • Contact B1's name and customer B's name on the second line stay inside contact B1's row and inside the list.
  • Contact B1's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12306 (Story 4, Authorizer list when someone else pays)

  • S4-R2: “Each contact shows its customer's name on a second line.”
  • S4-R1: “The Authorizer list shows "No authorizer", then the customer's authorizer contacts, then the Bill To's.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Authorizer list, top" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "Authorizer list, bottom" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-10-after-authorizer-list-top.png
  • bt-p2-11-after-authorizer-list-bottom.png

The design's own words:

  • “"No authorizer", then the customer's contacts, each with "Desert Edge Truck Service & Repair" on a second line.”
  • “The Bill To's contacts come last: "Jaime Johnson", "7 Star Truck Repair".”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
